notes.title: Update Notes for May 2nd
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendship XP heart animation now appears properly when gifting items to friends
[*] Flavor icons are now correctly hidden until the associated feature is available
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for March 11th
notes.notes:
- Fixed issues changing direction while riding mine carts when using a controller
- Various other small bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Update Notes for March 7th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Chococat won't be quest-locked (and following you everywhere) during the "Bring Your Own Bench" quest
[*] Steam achievement for Cabin Crazy is achievable
[*] Players should no longer lose control of their character after talking to Keroppi while at the Comedy Club
[*] Various other bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 12th
notes.notes:
Hello friends! Our newest Steam patch is now available. Here are the bugs we fixed:
[list]
[*] Cancel button in dialogue works more consistently
[*] UI in windowed mode is now more easily resizable
[*] Missing items from the Deluxe Event Bundle are being granted to players! If you have already unlocked this bundle, you will receive these items upon starting a session. If you have not unlocked the Deluxe Event Bundle, you will get all items at the same time once the quest requirements are reached.
[*] Fish Tales weekly quest - Players should be able to catch fish in Mount Hothead as intended
[/list]

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Update Notes for February 6th
notes.notes:
Hi Steam players! We have another update for you to download full of fixes and quest improvements, including;
[list]
[*] The Dye Station is no longer usable by multiplayer guests in order to situations where quests can break. Sorry for the inconvenience!
[*] Infinite scroll should no longer occur on menu screens.
[*] The one-day wait between the Make Yourself at Home and Friends & Family quests has been removed.
[*] Critter Lists no longer require tools in order to find them
[*] Pressing cancel when discussing Friendship Beads with Keroppi will cancel your purchase
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for February 4th
notes.notes:
Hello Steam players! There is a new update available for you to download.
 This includes several minor fixes, as well as fixing:
Occasional loss of interaction when playing on Keyboard + Mouse or on Controller
You can download now by pressing the blue 'Update' button that took the place of your Play button. Happy adventuring!
